## Background

The findings of the acceptance of the review-context task, filed as six parts. (Synthetic skeleton: the structure of api#168, shortened and relabelled `Part N`.)

## Scope

- Part 1 (PR): an excluded file must not reach the prompt
- Part 2 (PR): the Go resolver and parse errors
- Part 3 (PR): the pinned base of the DiffMap

- Part 5: the live check on staging

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Part 1: an excluded file is in no prompt
- [ ] Part 2: a parse failure forbids `resolved`
- [ ] Part 3: the DiffMap base equals the pinned base
- [ ] Part 4: the docs describe the runtime
- [ ] Part 5: the staging run is linked
- [ ] Part 6: `context.build` is written once per attempt
